Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000409" [decision]: As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000190": The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so the webhook dispatcher is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000340" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000185": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so the notifier is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000468": As of 2025-06-11, the Cinder team owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then.  (about: Boreal team, Cinder team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000458": From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000107" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000237": From 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000368" [decision]: Marcus took over the Boreal team on-call shift from Lena on 2025-05-07.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000426" [decision]: For anything Boreal-related, page Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000268" [constraint]: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000261" [decision]: Lena takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Marcus in the cycle starting 2025-03-17.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000296" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000225": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000291" [decision]: For anything related to the Ember team, page Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000174" [constraint]: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000161" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000312" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000134": The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
